findings.detail: Royal announcement EN 'following a sudden cardiac event' is medically nonspecific; RU 'вследствие внезапного сердечного приступа' asserts a heart attack. Restore nonspecific sudden cardiac problem in official statement.

EN 'receiving private care' in Palace announcement and newspaper recollection becomes RU 'проходит лечение в частном порядке' twice, specifying a treatment that the statement deliberately leaves open. Use neutral wording such as 'получает необходимую помощь в частном порядке'.
EN author note 'I am so thankful to all your comments and support' gives no author's gender; RU 'я безмерно благодарна' adds female gender. Recast neutrally without losing appreciation.
EN 'And unfairly handsome' rendered 'И до возмутительного красив' is ungrammatical; change to idiomatic 'И возмутительно красив'.
